observations: Photo 0 shows a flat, slim white console with a black strip across the middle, sitting on a wooden TV stand, with cables coming from behind.
Photo 1 shows the same flat white/black console on a TV stand beneath a wall-mounted TV playing a football game, with a small black box (possibly a router or set-top box) nearby.

The console's shape is thin, flat, and rectangular with a straight black dividing line down the middle - this matches the known body shape of a PS4 Slim, not the thick, curved, two-tone 'V' shape of a PlayStation 5.
No model plate, serial number, or logo is legible in either photo.
No controller, box, receipt, or power brick with visible labeling is shown.

identity.kind: gaming console (flat shape matches PS4 Slim body style, not the larger PS5 body)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a thin, flat console with a straight black divider line - this body shape and size matches a PS4 Slim, not the much larger, thicker, curved PS5 design.
No close-up of ports, vents, or casing wear is shown; usage condition cannot be judged from these angles.

risks.risk: Console may actually be a PS4 Slim mis-labeled as a PS5, a significant price difference
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the console's full body profile, side vents, and any printed model number (e.g., CUH-2xxx for PS4 or CFI-1xxx for PS5) on the underside or rear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value console (PS4 Slim), not as a PS5

risks.risk: Unknown working condition - no power-on, controller pairing, or menu screen shown
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the console powered on with the home screen or system settings visible showing software version/model

risks.risk: No accessories (controller, cables, box) confirmed included
risks.proof: Photo showing controller, power cable, and HDMI cable laid out together with the console

risks.risk: Storage capacity and any internal modifications unknown
risks.proof: Photo of console settings screen showing storage info, or rear/bottom label with capacity stated

proof_requests: Photo of the console's rear or underside showing the printed model number and serial plate
Photo or clip of the console powered on, showing the home screen/system menu
Photo showing all included accessories (controller, cables) together with the console
Close-up photo of the side vents/edges to compare against known PS4 vs PS5 body shapes
response.reason: The photographed console's flat, thin shape with a straight dividing line matches a PS4 Slim, not the distinctly larger and differently shaped PlayStation 5, so the seller's claim of a PS5 appears to misrepresent the item pictured.
